data.one_liner: A customizable country selector widget with search, phone codes, and detailed country information.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CountrySelector widget that lets users choose a country from a customizable list or grid. It supports features like preferred countries, alphabetical tap-to-search, phone codes, and detailed country info including capitals, currencies, and languages.
use_when: You need a country picker or phone country code selector in your form or settings.
You want detailed country information such as calling codes, currencies, and languages.
avoid_when: You require complex non-country pickers or general-purpose list pickers.
strengths: Includes extensive country metadata (capital, currency, time zone, popular sports, etc.).
Offers rich customization options for app bars, search bars, and list items.
Supports alphabetical tap-to-search and preferred countries.
weaknesses: Limited to country selection use cases.
Very few pub.dev topics and limited community metrics documented.
data.setup_notes: Add CountryLocalizations.delegate to your app's localizationsDelegates if you use localization.
